attributes.daySummary: I had a super day at school, and I learned lots of new things!

whatIWorkedOn.subject: Math
whatIWorkedOn.description: During Direct Instruction math, I practiced counting to 5 using hands-on counting tools. I touched each block carefully one at a time.

whatIWorkedOn.subject: Language
whatIWorkedOn.description: In my Language for Learning lesson, I pointed to pictures when someone asked me to show them things.

whatIWorkedOn.subject: Social Skills
whatIWorkedOn.description: During lunch, I ate all my food on my own and asked for a napkin using my words.

whatIWorkedOn.subject: Social Skills
whatIWorkedOn.description: I played a greeting game with my friends. I waved and said hi to lots of classmates!

whatIWorkedOn.subject: General
whatIWorkedOn.description: I packed my bag all by myself and got ready to go home.

attributes.todaysHighlight: I built a really tall tower with blocks during free choice! I showed it to Emmy and said, 'Look, tall!'
attributes.teacherNotes: Jamie had a wonderful day! She is making great progress toward her learning goals. She got 4 out of 5 on her counting activity and 8 out of 10 on her language identification. It's wonderful to see her using her words to interact with her friends and following classroom routines so well.
